text:
maria-finance: Heads up - EcoThera (acct: ECO-458) invoice INV-8923 attempted payment twice and both paths failed. Need quick plan, customer on a tight deadline.

payments-bot: Automated notice: charge_attempt failed for INV-8923. decline_code=issuer_decline, avs_result=unavailable. txn_id=ch_3Kx...

nora-billing: Ugh. Card fail first, then ACH microdeposit never verified? Any error from the ACH provider?

maria-finance: Card declined with issuer_decline on 2024-11-25 14:02 PST. Then we triggered ACH setup flow - microdeposits created but customer reports they never received amounts. Provider logs show `microdeposit_status: returned` for routing_number 000000.

sam-support: Customer says they used their payroll account. They attached a screenshot of bank portal that lists the account holder as "EcoThera LLC" but their legal name on file is "EcoTherapy Inc." Might be name mismatch. Customer asked for wire option.

devon-ops: If it's a name mismatch, ACH will likely bounce. Wire is safer. What approvals do we need to accept a manual wire and mark invoice as paid?

maria-finance: We need manual approval from finance lead to accept wire and mark invoice settled in billing system. Also need to supply wire instructions and remind customer to include invoice number.

alan-cfo: I can sign off. Confirm the amount and remediation steps first. Are there any elevated fraud flags on the account?

maria-finance: Amount is $42,750. No fraud alerts in the past 6 months. Regular usage. Customer has been on enterprise plan since Q3.

nora-billing: Ok. I'll draft a manual wire approval and add hold-release checklist: 1) Confirm wire remittance includes INV-8923, 2) Confirm sender account matches customer profile, 3) Reconcile SWIFT/beneficiary reference.

maria-finance: Drafted text for customer message: ```Hi EcoThera - we can accept a wire for INV-8923. Please send funds to: Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Bank: Northport Clearing; Account: ****1234; SWIFT: NCRTUS33; Reference: INV-8923 and your customer ID ECO-458. Once funds clear, we'll mark invoice paid.```

sam-support: Suggest adding a small checklist for them to screenshot remittance confirmation to speed reconciliation.

devon-ops: Also note internal ops: when we mark invoice paid, trigger a usage recount job to avoid duplicate credits. I'll add a one-off reconciliation task id=rec-2101.

payments-bot: Wire_pending created by maria-finance. approval_required=true. approver=alan-cfo.

alan-cfo: Approved. Please confirm refund window / credit policy if wire arrives late.

maria-finance: Approved by Alan. Action items: - Send wire instructions to EcoThera (sam-support to send) - Add manual payment method in Billing UI and set state=awaiting_funds (nora) - Reconcile once funds post and release access (devon) - Notify customer with screenshot checklist (sam)

sam-support: Sending message now to customer DM and support@ecothera. I'll include the screenshot checklist and ask them to cc payments@ecothera.com on the bank remittance.

nora-billing: I created billing task TB-421 in StripeOps with notes to watch for remittance reference INV-8923 and ECO-458.

maria-finance: Thanks. Follow up: if wire can't be used, we may offer ACH via our backup aggregator (requires them to update legal entity name). Will note that as fallback.

sam-support: Customer replied: "Will initiate wire today and send remittance screenshot. Thanks for the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:

maria-finance: Great - closing thread once funds clear. Will post final reconciliation here.

payments-bot: Thread updated: last_action=approval_completed, assigned_to=sam-support, task_id=TB-421.
